before.text: (define task scope)

after.text: ext/goal accounting (ext/goal/src/accounting.rs, ext/goal/src/extension.rs event wiring) plus the minimal extension-api surface needed to observe committed effects. No pacing timer in this leaf (that is TASK-260929-309h9n). Keep the existing activity booleans and the three-empty-turn blocker untouched; add separate compact observations. No core->goal dependency.

before.text: (define acceptance criteria)

after.text: AC1 A per-goal-turn observation records whether at least one STATE-CHANGING outcome was observed. Resets come only from: an applied file change (patch/edit actually applied), an actual plan transition (update_plan whose content differs from the previous plan), a committed goal mutation, and an accepted spawn/follow-up. Each is recorded at its committing handler or event, not at ToolFinish success (plan section 8; ext/goal/src/extension.rs:457-468). AC2 Non-resets, each driven by a named test: a failed tool, an identical plan resubmission, a successful read-only command (ps/tail) or an arbitrary shell success, a code-mode wrapper success, and a model text that claims progress. AC3 Code-mode leaves are counted once: one nested leaf that applies a file change yields exactly one observation, and the wrapper adds none (test with a narrowing mutant that double-counts or counts the wrapper). AC4 No model-writable bypass: no tool argument, plan text or message content can set the observation (test). AC5 The existing activity booleans and the three-fully-empty-continuations blocker (ext/goal/src/accounting.rs:216-229) behave exactly as before (regression tests stay green; one test asserts the blocker still fires first). AC6 The observation is transient: it is not persisted to rollout or history, and resume starts with no carried observation (test). AC7 Arbitrary shell side effects are a stated bound: the results file must say that they are unknown, so pacing may stay conservative and completion is never inferred from them. AC8 Every gate (each reset source and each non-reset) ships a narrowing mutant with a named killer test, per the checklist.
